snippet.description:
태국 수린에는 집집마다 코끼리를 키우는 특별한 마을이 있습니다.
한 마리에 1억 원이 넘기도 하는 코끼리가 골목을 돌아다니고, 사람들은 코끼리를 타고 마을을 오갑니다. 동네 호수에서는 코끼리들이 목욕을 하고, 어떤 코끼리는 훌라후프를 돌리고 하모니카까지 붑니다.

역마살로드는 태국 수린의 코끼리 마을을 찾아 일주일 동안 코끼리들을 직접 돌보며 생활했습니다.
매일 아침 코끼리 똥을 치우고, 풀과 나뭇가지를 구해 먹이를 준비하고, 코끼리와 함께 산책하며 마훗(코끼리 조련사)의 일상을 경험했습니다.

하지만 가장 큰 문제는 따로 있었습니다. 잠시도 가만히 있지 않는 말썽꾸러기 새끼 코끼리! 가방을 뒤지고, 청소를 방해하고, 심지어 머리채까지 잡아당깁니다.
그런데 이 마을의 코끼리들에게는 우리가 몰랐던 사연이 있었습니다.

과거 태국에서 벌목과 운송에 동원됐던 코끼리들. 벌목 산업이 쇠퇴하면서 많은 코끼리와 조련사들이 생계를 찾아 도시로 떠나야 했습니다. 이후 코끼리들을 고향으로 돌아오게 하려는 노력이 시작됐습니다.
태국 수린의 코끼리 마을에는 왜 이렇게 많은 코끼리가 살고 있을까요?

코끼리와 함께 살아가는 사람들의 일상, 말썽꾸러기 새끼 코끼리와의 일주일, 그리고 코끼리들이 고향으로 돌아오게 된 이야기를 담았습니다.

snippet.title: LEVENT GÜLTEKİN:ÖZGÜR ÖZEL CEMAL ENGİNYURT İLE ADNAN BEKER'LE İKTİDAR OLAMAZ  #özgürözel
snippet.description:
LEVENT GÜLTEKİN:

'Özgür Özel'in cumartesi günü Güvenpark'ta yaptığı toplantıda bir yanında Adnan Beker, öbür yanında Cemal Enginyurt var.

Bunlarla yeni bir umut yaratamazsın. Cemal Enginyurt'la, Adnan Beker'le çıktığın yol seni parlak bir yere götüremez.

Bu hayatın doğal akışına aykırı bir şey. Cemal Bey'in MHP'ye kayyum atanmasındaki rolünden tut, İmamoğlu'na dış güçlerin adamı demesinden al getir.

 Özgür Özel'e ağzına gel küfürleri etmesinden al getir. Kılıçdaroğlu kongreyi kaybettiğinde gidip Kılıçdaroğlu'nun mihmandarlığına soyunması. Meşhurdur o biliyorsun herkes Kılıçdaroğlu'na bırak git yeter dediğinde.

Cemal Enginyurt Kılıçdaroğlu'nun arabasına binip video çekiyordu. Bana diyorlar ki sen niye Kılıçdaroğlu'nu destekliyorsun?

Ne yapacağım hırsızları mı destekleyeyim diyen bir adam. Adnan Beker dediğin Ankara'da işte bu Ayhan Bora Kaplan iddianamesine bir şekilde adı geçiyor oralarda bu tip bir adam.

2023 seçimlerinde Kılıçdaroğlu'na oy vermedim, Erdoğan'a oy verdim diyen bir adam. Sen bunlarla bir toplumsal muhalefetin ilgisini çekebilecek bir organizasyon yapamazsın.

Ve Özgür Bey'in, yani lider dediğim o ağırlık,o birikim malesef sende yok tepkisellikle iş götürüyor..''

snippet.title: Remain | Official Trailer

When everything else is gone, love Remains. #RemainMovie - only in theaters February 5, 2027. 

From Warner Bros. Pictures, Remain, starring Jake Gyllenhaal, is an unprecedented collaboration between two of the world’s most creative minds: best-selling author Nicholas Sparks, and visionary filmmaker M. Night Shyamalan.

When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

Gyllenhaal stars alongside Phoebe Dynevor, Ashley Walters, Julie Hagerty and Jay O. Sanders.

Shyamalan directs from his own screenplay, story by Shyamalan and Sparks. The film is produced by Shyamalan, Ashwin Rajan, Marc Bienstock and Theresa Park, with Sparks executive producing.

Joining Shyamalan behind the camera are director of photography Adolpho Veloso, production designer Sam Lisenco, editor Noëmi Preiswerk, costume designer Caroline Duncan, casting director Douglas Aibel, music supervisor Gabe Hilfer and composer James Newton Howard.

Warner Bros. Pictures Presents a Blinding Edge Pictures Production, an M. Night Shyamalan Film, Remain, in theaters across North America February 5, 2027, and
internationally beginning 3 February 2027, distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures.

Ahmet Şık, eşi Yonca Verdioğlu Şık’ın casusluk suçlamasıyla gözaltına alınması ve yakın arkadaşı Ahmet Saymadi’nin tutuklanmasına ilişkin çarpıcı iddialarda bulundu. Fon soruşturmasında bazı isimlerin korunduğunu, bilgilerin muhalefeti itibarsızlaştırmak amacıyla sızdırıldığını ve etkili bir bürokratın büyükelçi olarak atanabileceğini öne sürdü.

Fon mağdurlarının büyük bölümünün AKP ve MHP seçmeni olduğunu savunan Şık, SPK'nın denetim sorumluluğunu, soruşturmadaki isim listelerini, yurt dışına çıkarıldığı iddia edilen milyarlarca lirayı ve krizin Erdoğan iktidarına olası siyasi etkilerini değerlendirdi.

Şık ayrıca fon krizinin Türkiye'deki gelir eşitsizliği, yoksulluk ve siyasi hesaplaşmalarla bağlantısını ele alarak muhalefete ortak mücadele çağrısında bulundu. #AhmetŞık #FonVurgunu #FonSoruşturması

THE FINANCIAL BLINDSPOT  
One of the biggest mistakes investors make is assuming that whatever worked over the last few years will keep working forever. I made that mistake with real estate, and I think a lot of investors are making a similar mistake today with stocks. The investments making you the most money can also quietly create the most risk.

THE CONCENTRATION TRAP  
A lot of people think owning an S&P 500 index fund automatically means they are fully diversified. But roughly 10 companies now make up more than a third of the entire index. That means a surprisingly large percentage of your money could be tied to the same handful of businesses.

WHY CONCENTRATION CAN BECOME DANGEROUS  
Concentration feels great when the biggest companies keep winning. The problem is that if those companies struggle, the rest of the index may not be able to offset the decline. That is similar to what happened to me with real estate, where I owned multiple properties but they were all exposed to the same city and the same risks.

AI CAN WIN AND INVESTORS CAN STILL LOSE  
I believe artificial intelligence will change almost everything, but that does not mean every AI investment works out. During the dot-com bubble, the internet absolutely changed the world, but companies like Cisco still lost enormous amounts of value. You can be right about the technology and still pay the wrong price.

THE RISK RESET  
My goals today are different from when I first started investing. Years ago, I was focused almost entirely on maximizing growth. Today, I care much more about stability, flexibility, and protecting what I have already built.

MY 2027 INVESTING PLAN  
Most of my portfolio is still invested in low cost U.S. and international index funds. I also have roughly 15% to 20% in tax-free municipal bonds, around 10% to 12% in a Bitcoin ETF, and the rest spread between cash and personal-use real estate. What is changing is where I am putting new money.

MORE INTERNATIONAL EXPOSURE  
I still like the S&P 500, but I am not completely comfortable having so much exposure dependent on the same handful of companies. Because of that, I am gradually increasing my international allocation.

MORE BONDS  
I am also putting more money into tax-free municipal bonds. At this stage, I like having part of my portfolio generating relatively predictable income without the same level of volatility as stocks.

MORE CASH AND FLEXIBILITY  
I am being more intentional about keeping cash available. If we experience a prolonged downturn, I want to be able to ride it out without changing my lifestyle or being forced to sell.

REBALANCING BITCOIN WITHOUT SELLING  
I am still invested in Bitcoin, but it has become a larger percentage of my portfolio than I would ideally want. Rather than selling it, I plan to balance the allocation by directing new money elsewhere.

THE STRESS TEST  
Before 2027, look at everything you own and ask how much of your money is really riding on the same bet. Then decide what you would do if markets fell 20%, 30%, or 40%.

YOU DO NOT HAVE TO SELL EVERYTHING  
If your portfolio is more concentrated than you want, you can simply redirect new contributions toward areas where you want more exposure.

THE BIGGEST LESSON  
There is no single strategy that makes sense for every stage of life. When you are younger, time, savings rate, and consistently investing may matter most. As wealth grows, preservation and flexibility can become more important. The goal is not to maximize every possible dollar. It is to build a portfolio that gives you freedom without becoming something you constantly worry about.

snippet.title: Brad Built a Machine Only Smart People Can See, and I Saw an Empty Table 🪑 #roblox #funny
snippet.description:
Brad built a machine that only smart people can see. I saw a table. Everyone else loved it: Benny pressed the red buttons, Miss Stern asked him to turn it down, the janitor dusted it, and the principal burned his finger on it. I asked what color it was. Red, blue and stripes. So I told the truth... and everyone laughed at me. If I couldn't see it, I couldn't walk around it.

snippet.title: Ningún Dispositivo Podía Demostrar Que Einstein Estaba Equivocado... Hasta Ahora
snippet.description:
¿Pueden los relojes atómicos demostrar que Einstein estaba equivocado?

Suscríbete al boletín de Veritasium para recibir novedades científicas cada semana: https://ve42.co/Newsletter

Muchísimas gracias a NIST por su ayuda para hacer este video. Visita su sitio web: https://www.nist.gov/pml/time-and-fre...

Únete a nuestro Patreon para tener la oportunidad de recibir una calcomanía de la NASA que llegó al borde del espacio durante el eclipse y obtener acceso anticipado a videos que aún están en producción: https://ve42.co/VePatreon

El año pasado, lanzamos Elements of Truth en Kickstarter y nos emocionó muchísimo la respuesta. Ahora estamos en las etapas finales de producción y las recompensas de Kickstarter se enviarán muy pronto. Si te perdiste la campaña, ahora puedes reservar la edición comercial a través de nuestro nuevo sitio web aquí: https://ve42.co/YTDEcl

Si apoyaste nuestra campaña en Kickstarter, no te preocupes: tu juego se enviará antes de que se procesen los pedidos anticipados.

▀▀▀

8:51 Cómo usar láseres para enfriar átomos

19:00 Volando un reloj atómico en un helicóptero

28:40 Peines de frecuencias ópticas
30:42 ¿Sigue teniendo razón Einstein?

▀▀▀

Un agradecimiento especial a los expertos y colaboradores que hicieron posible este video:

En orden de aparición: el profesor Jonathan Oppenheim (University College London), Greg Hoth (NIST), el Dr. Andrew Ludlow (NIST), la Dra. Laura Sinclair (NIST), el Dr. Harikesh Ranganath (NIST), Lilani Toms-Hardman (University of Western Australia), el profesor Sascha Schediwy (University of Western Australia), la Dra. Sabrina Slimani (University of Western Australia) y el Dr. Benjamin Dix-Matthews (University of Western Australia).

Al National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), la University of Denver y el Meyer-Womble Observatory, la University of Western Australia y el International Centre for Radio Astronomy Research, RIKEN y la University of Tokyo. Además, al Precision Measurement Group (PMG) del Institute for Photonics, Advanced Sensing and Quantum Technologies (IPAS-QT) de Adelaide University, que proporcionó los dos relojes atómicos portátiles utilizados en la prueba de UWA: https://ve42.co/AdelaideUniversityPre...

Durante la producción de este video participaron Rebecca Jacobson, la Dra. Emily Caldwell, el Dr. Kyle Latty (NIST), Nicholas Kurth, University of Colorado (Boulder), el Dr. Bryn Crawford (Adelaide University), el profesor Hidetoshi Katori, el profesor asociado Kai Suekane, el Dr. Shota Yo y el Dr. Hiutat Yang (RIKEN y University of Tokyo).

En la investigación y revisión adicionales participaron el profesor David Kaiser (MIT), el profesor Scott Diddams (University of Colorado Boulder), la profesora Claudia de Rham (Imperial College London), el profesor Steven Cundiff (University of Michigan) y el Dr. Derek van Westrum (NOAA National Geodetic Survey).

Agradecemos también al NIST Archive, al profesor Jun Ye (NIST/JILA) y a Brent Doerzman por su apoyo con material de archivo.
